title_jp: {離れて|はなれて}いるからこそ
context: Monday 21 December: after a video call with his mother, アルちゃん feels homesick for the first time: it's his first Christmas away from his family. At the kotatsu, {田中|たなか}さん gives him advice in his own quiet way.
scene: Monday night at the kotatsu. You've just hung up on your mum in Spain and gone quiet. {田中|たなか}さん notices.

phrases.jp: {寂しい|さびしい|lonely|3}{時|とき}こそ、{誰か|だれか}と{話した|はなした}ほうがいいよ。
phrases.en: It's exactly when you're lonely that you should talk to someone.
phrases.note: 〜{時|とき}こそ = precisely when… A classic piece of advice.

phrases.jp: こちらこそ、よろしくお{願い|ねがい}します。
phrases.en: The pleasure's mine. (No, I should be thanking you.)
phrases.note: Reply to よろしく or ありがとう: 'no, it's me who…'

phrases.jp: {泣きたい|なきたい}ときは、{思い切り|おもいきり|to your heart's content|3}{泣いて|ないて}いいんだよ。
phrases.en: When you want to cry, it's fine to have a good cry.
phrases.note: 〜ていいんだよ = it's OK to… Gentle and warm.

phrases.jp: {来年|らいねん}こそ、N3に{合格|ごうかく|passing (an exam)|3}するぞ！
phrases.en: Next year I'm passing N3, for sure!
phrases.note: Heard everywhere in late December: {来年|らいねん}こそ…!

phrases.jp: ホームシックになったら、{家族|かぞく}の{写真|しゃしん}を{眺める|ながめる|to gaze at|3}といいよ。
phrases.en: When you get homesick, it helps to look at photos of your family.
phrases.note: 〜といいよ = it's good to… Friendly advice.

dialogue_setting: The {田中|たなか} living room, Monday evening. {恵子|けいこ}さん is in the bath; the TV is on with the sound low.

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.jp: {昨日|きのう}のパエリア、うまかっただに。…どうした、{調子|ちょうし|condition, shape|4}{悪い|わるい}のか。
dialogue.en: Yesterday's paella was really good. …What's up, feeling off?
dialogue.note: だに = emphasis (Nagano), like だよ.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {母|はは}とビデオ{通話|つうわ|(phone) call|3}したら、{急に|きゅうに}{家族|かぞく}に{会いたく|あいたく}なっちゃって…
dialogue.en: I had a video call with my mum, and suddenly I really wanted to see my family…

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.jp: {寂しい|さびしい|lonely|3}{時|とき}こそ、{体|からだ}を{動かす|うごかす|to move|4}といい。{明日|あした}、{枝|えだ|branch|3}の{雪|ゆき}{落とし|おとし}を{手伝え|てつだえ}。
dialogue.en: It's exactly when you're lonely that you should move your body. Tomorrow, help me knock the snow off the branches.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: はい。…{家族|かぞく}と{離れて|はなれて|to be apart|3}{過ごす|すごす}クリスマスは{初めて|はじめて}なんです。{ホームシック||homesick|3}かも。
dialogue.en: OK. …It's my first Christmas away from my family. Maybe I'm homesick.

dialogue.speaker: 田中さん
dialogue.jp: {離れて|はなれて|to be apart|3}いるからこそ、{家族|かぞく}の{有り難さ|ありがたさ|value, gratitude|3}が{分かる|わかる}。それに、ここもアルちゃんの{家|いえ}だに。
dialogue.en: It's because you're apart that you see what family means. And besides, this is your home too.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: …ありがとうございます。その{言葉|ことば}に、すごく{励まされました|はげまされました|to encourage|3}。
dialogue.en: …Thank you. Those words really cheered me up.

listening.intro: As he gets up to go to bed, {田中|たなか}さん adds one more thing. Type it.

lines.jp: {明日|あした}は{五時|ごじ}{起き|おき}だに。{早く|はやく}{寝ろ|ねろ}。
lines.en: Tomorrow we're up at five. Get to bed early.

grammar.form: noun + こそ ({来年|らいねん}こそ, こちらこそ) · time + こそ ({寂|さび}しい{時|とき}こそ) · reason + からこそ ({離|はな}れているからこそ, だからこそ)
grammar.explanation: こそ puts a spotlight on one thing: 'this, and no other'. {来年|らいねん}こそ = next year for sure (unlike this one). からこそ = precisely because. After thanks or an apology, こちらこそ = 'no, I should say that'. It's stronger than は or が.

examples.jp: {今度|こんど}こそ、{絶対|ぜったい}{勝つ|かつ}で！
examples.en: This time I'm winning for sure! (says {健太|けんた})

examples.jp: {田舎|いなか|countryside|3}だからこそ、{星|ほし}がきれいに{見える|みえる}。
examples.en: It's precisely because it's the countryside that you can see the stars so well.

quiz.question: 「いつもありがとう」「いえ、こちら＿＿」
quiz.explain: こちらこそ = it's me who should say it.

quiz_more.question: {失敗|しっぱい}した＿＿、{分かる|わかる}こともある。
quiz_more.en: There are things you understand precisely because you failed.
quiz_more.explain: からこそ = exactly because of that.

quiz_more.question: {今年|ことし}はダメだった。{来年|らいねん}＿＿{頑張る|がんばる}！
quiz_more.en: This year didn't work out. Next year for sure!
quiz_more.explain: {来年|らいねん}こそ: next year, and not like this one.

kanji.where: On your phone screen, the moment your mum hangs up.
kanji.breakdown: {通話|つうわ} call ({通|つう} pass through + {話|わ} talk) + {終了|しゅうりょう} end ({終|しゅう} finish + {了|りょう} complete) → the call is over.
kanji.related: {営業終了|えいぎょうしゅうりょう} = closed for the day (shops).

tip.title: How care sounds
tip.body: Older Japanese men like {田中|たなか}さん rarely comfort you with soft words. They give you food, a bath, or a job to do tomorrow: that's the kindness. A short それに、ここも{家|いえ}だ from them means a lot.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん, out of the bath: 「{昨日|きのう}はパエリア、ありがとうね」 Reply that it's you who should thank them, always. One part is wrong.

parts.why: だけ means 'only'. To say 'no, it's me who should thank you', use こちらこそ.

parts.jp: ありがとうございます。

challenge.model_answer: いえ、こちらこそ、いつもありがとうございます。
challenge.explanation: When someone thanks you and you feel you owe them more, こちらこそ turns it around: 'no, thank YOU'. いつも adds 'for everything, all the time'. ありがとうございます keeps it polite with your host.

vocab.note: ビデオ{通話|つうわ} = video call. {無料通話|むりょうつうわ} on LINE.
{動|うご}く = it moves; {動|うご}かす = you move it. {体|からだ}を{動|うご}かす = exercise.
Heavy snow can snap apple branches, so farmers knock it off.
〜と{離|はな}れる = be away from. {離|はな}れて{住|す}む = live apart.
ホームシックになる = get homesick.

vocab.en: precious, something to be grateful for
vocab.note: Root of ありがとう. {有|あ}り{難|がた}さ = how precious something is.
{励|はげ}まされる = be encouraged. Noun: {励|はげ}まし.

vocab.en: to your heart's content, with all your might
vocab.note: {思|おも}い{切|き}り{遊|あそ}ぶ, {思|おも}い{切|き}り{笑|わら}う.
Looking for a long time: views, photos. {眺|なが}め = a view.

kanji_study.parts: 离 a net or trap + 隹 small bird → a bird slipping out of the net and flying off: separate.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 難 (difficult): both have 隹 bird, but 難 has 堇 on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 言 words + 周 all around → going all around with questions: investigate. Also tuning something until it's right: condition.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 週 (week): 週 has 辶 road, 調 has 言 words.

extras.title: Comforting someone
extras.title_jp: {励ます|はげます|to encourage|3}{言葉|ことば}
extras.intro: Short lines that help a friend who's down.

items.jp: いつでも{話|はなし}、{聞く|きく}よ。
items.en: I'm here to listen, any time.

extras.title: Missing home
extras.intro: Other ways to say you miss home.

items.jp: {家族|かぞく}が{恋しい|こいしい|to miss (someone)|3}。
items.note: {恋|こい}しい = longing for someone or somewhere far away.

items.jp: {実家|じっか}の{料理|りょうり}が{食べたい|たべたい}な。
items.en: I want to eat food from home.

items.jp: {声|こえ}を{聞いたら|きいたら}、{元気|げんき}が{出た|でた}。
items.en: Hearing their voice cheered me up.
